title_en: Selections on the Stations of the Chosen One (peace be upon him and his family) (3)
description_en: The program 'Discussions in Creed' by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure) on Al-Kawthar TV channel. Selections on the stations of the Chosen One (peace be upon him and his family).
summary: This is an episode of the program 'Discussions in Creed' exploring the lofty stations and attributes of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).
series_en: Discussions in Creed - Selections on the Stations of the Chosen One
